newsitem.title: GREECE: Drachma up vs yen, Ecu, mark in January.
newsitem.headline: Drachma up vs yen, Ecu, mark in January.

text.p: The drachma rose against the yen, the Ecu, the mark and the French franc month-on-month in January but fell versus the U.S dollar and British pound and was stable vis-a-vis the Italian lira, Ionian Research said in its monthly report.

The drachma advanced 1.12 percent month-on-month against the yen, 0.93 percent against the mark, 0.81 percent against the French franc, 0.26 percent against the ecu but fell 2.54 percent against the dollar and 2.18 percent versus the pound, it said.
The drachma was stable against the Italian lira, losing a meagre 0.12 percent month-on-month in January.
The U.S dollar appreciated 4.60 percent year-on-year against the drachma in January, the pound 13.39 percent, the lira 5.68 percent and the Ecu 0.20 percent, it said.
The yen was down 6.33 percent year-on-year versus the drachma, the mark 4.82 percent and the French franc 3.40 percent, it said.
All calculations are based on average monthly fixing figures. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
